source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part B (Nonferrous Material Specifications) — SB-435 - Specification for UNS N06002, UNS N06230, UNS N12160, and UNS R30556 Plate, Sheet, and Strip — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

children.html: SPECIFICATION FOR UNS N06002, UNS N06230, UNS N12160, AND UNS R30556 PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
(Identical with ASTM Specification B435-06(2016) except that certification and test reports have been made mandatory.)
Specification for UNS N06002, UNS N06230, UNS N12160, and UNS R30556 Plate, Sheet, and Strip
1.1 This specification covers alloys UNS N06002, UNS N06230, UNS N12160, and UNS R30556 in the form of rolled plate, sheet, and strip for heat-resisting and general corrosive service.
1.2 The following products are covered under this specification:
1.2.1 Sheet and Strip—Hot- or cold-rolled, annealed, and descaled unless solution annealing is performed in an atmosphere yielding a bright finish.

1.3 The values stated in inch-pound units are to be regarded as standard. The values given in parentheses are mathematical conversions to SI units that are provided for information only and are not considered standard.

1.4 This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use. It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to become familiar with all hazards including those identified in the appropriate Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this product/material as provided by the manufacturer, to establish appropriate safety and health practices, and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.
2.1 ASTM Standards: B906 Specification for General Requirements for Flat-
Rolled Nickel and Nickel Alloys Plate, Sheet, and Strip
E527 Practice for Numbering Metals and Alloys in the Unified Numbering System (UNS)
3.1 Definitions of Terms Specific to This Standard:
3.1.1 plate, n—material 3⁄16 in. (4.76 mm) and over in thickness.
3.1.2 sheet and strip, n—material under 3⁄16 in. (4.76 mm) in thickness.
4.1 Material furnished under this specification shall conform to the applicable requirements of Specification B906 unless otherwise provided herein.

5.1 It is the responsibility of the purchaser to specify all requirements that are necessary for material ordered under this specification. Examples of such requirements include, but are not limited to the following:
5.1.2 Dimensions—Thickness (in decimals of an inch), width, and length (inch or fraction of an inch),
5.1.3 Certification—Certification and test reports are required,
5.1.4 Optional Requirement—Plate; state how plate is to be cut (Specification B906, Table titled Permissible Variations in width and Length of Sheared, Torch-Cut, or Abrasive-Cut Rectangular Plate),
5.1.5 Purchase Inspection—State which tests or inspections are to be witnessed (Specification B906, section on Inspection), and
5.1.6 Samples for Product (Check) Analysis—State whether samples should be furnished (Specification B906, section on Sampling).
6.1 The material shall conform to the requirements as to chemical composition prescribed in Table 1.
6.2 If a product (check) analysis is made by the purchaser, the material shall conform to the requirements specified in Table 1 and Specification B906.
7.1 Tensile Properties—The material shall conform to the room temperature tensile properties prescribed in Table 2.
7.2 Grain Size for Sheet and Strip:
7.2.1 Annealed alloys UNS N06002, UNS N06230, and UNS R30556 sheet and strip shall conform to the grain size requirements given in Table 3.
7.2.2 Annealed alloy UNS N12160 shall conform to an average grain size of ASTM No. 5 or coarser.
8.1 Weight—For calculations of mass or weight, the following densities shall be used:

8.2.1 Sheet and Strip—The thickness shall be measured with the micrometer spindle 3⁄8 in. (9.525 mm) or more from any edge for material 1 in. (25.4 mm) or over in width and at any place on material under 1 in. in width.
8.3.1 Sheet and Strip—Sheet and strip may be ordered to cut lengths, in which case a variation of 1⁄8 in. (3.175 mm) over the specified length shall be permitted, with a 0 minus tolerance.

8.4.1 The edgewise curvature (depth of chord) of flat sheet, strip, and plate shall not exceed the product of 0.05 in. multiplied by the length in feet (0.04 mm multiplied by the length in centimetres).
8.4.2 Straightness for coiled strip is subject to agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.
8.5 Squareness (Sheet)—For sheets of all thicknesses and widths of 6 in. (152.4 mm) or more, the angle between adjacent sides shall be 90 6 0.15° (1⁄16 in. in 24 in. or 2.6 mm/m).
8.6 Flatness—Plate, sheet, and strip shall be commercially flat.
8.7.1 Plates shall have sheared, abrasive-cut or plasmatorch-cut edges as specified.
8.7.2 Sheet and strip shall have sheared or slit edges.

9.1 Each plate, sheet, or strip shall be marked on one face with the specification number, alloy, heat number, manufacturer's identification, and size. The markings shall have no deleterious effect on the material or its performance and shall be sufficiently stable to withstand normal handling.
UNS N06002 UNS N06230 UNS R30556 UNS N12160
A D refers to the diameter of the tension specimen.
B Solution annealed at a temperature between 2200 and 2275°F (1204 and 1246°C) followed by a water quench or rapidly cooled by other means.

9.2 Each bundle or shipping container shall be marked with the name of the material; this specification number; alloy; the size; gross, tare, and net weight; consignor and consignee address; contract or order number; and such other information as may be defined in the contract or order.
